history.summary: Second run today — Vlad supplied the full updated exclude list and 4 mThink Blue Book URLs, then refined focus to US/UK/DE only after first attempt covered too many fringe GEOs (MENA/AU/FR). 11 searches across mThink, Business of Apps, AdWeek, G2, Affpaying, regional German/UK sources. 6 approved (LTK and Mavely dropped as not relevant for our buyers).

affiliate_networks.name: AdCell
affiliate_networks.description: The mid-market leader for German-speaking countries. 2,500+ partner programs, 60K+ active publishers. Pure performance-based (CPS/CPL/CPA). Strong in retail, finance, contests, insurance.

affiliate_networks.name: digidip
affiliate_networks.description: Berlin-based content-commerce platform — auto-converts editorial outbound links into affiliate-tracked links via a JS snippet. Aggregates inventory from multiple sub-networks. Founded 2013, ranked #9 in Germany's fastest-growing startups.

affiliate_networks.name: Optimise Media
affiliate_networks.description: UK HQ global affiliate & partnership marketing network. Delivers $1B+ in attributed sales/year. Premium enterprise tier. Strong SE Asia + ANZ + global ecom case studies (22% B2C share, 4× growth).
affiliate_networks.geo: UK HQ, global (strong SE Asia + ANZ)

affiliate_networks.name: ShopMy
affiliate_networks.description: Modern US creator network. 10–30% commissions (substantially higher than LTK's 3–14%). 1K+ followers entry bar. Weekly Friday payouts, $25 min. Auto-monetization applies highest available rate to every link. Fashion/beauty/lifestyle.

affiliate_networks.name: Madrivo
affiliate_networks.description: First company to debut as Top-5 on mThink's Blue Book. 27.6B impressions/year, 3M+ qualified leads. Premium reputation, strict compliance, exclusive top-tier advertisers. Multi-channel: Display/Email/Mobile/Native/Social/Search/Video.
affiliate_networks.source: Affpaying + Kochava + ADSWikia + mThink Blue Book

affiliate_networks.name: GuruMedia
affiliate_networks.description: Operating since 2010 as exclusive CPS network. 2,000+ exclusive offers. CPS payouts $28–$120+ per sale, eCom up to $70. Weekly payments, $1 min via PayPal/Skrill. Hands-on support, rigorous quality control.
affiliate_networks.geo: Top GEOs: US, UK, CA, DE, FR, AU

history.summary: Deep manual run — Vlad asked for quality over quantity, real networks only. 14 searches across mThink, Business of Apps, RichAds/ROIads roundups, Affpaying, Crunchbase, regional-language sources (Brazil, Nordics, CIS, India). Roster is getting heavy, so the bar was high: only candidates not in any prior discovery or roster, passing ecom CPS/CPA (for ANs) and Pop/Popunder+ISP (for TSs). 3 strong ANs in fresh GEOs (Nordics, LATAM, CIS+APAC) and 1 TS with full ISP/carrier targeting.

affiliate_networks.name: Adservice
affiliate_networks.description: Leading Nordic affiliate network since 2007. Presence in DK/SE/NO/FI/DE/ES/FR/MX. Performance-based, only paid on actual sales. Strong in Norway (loans/credit cards) but full ecom portfolio across the Nordics. Note: currently unifying operations with Adtraction.
affiliate_networks.source: Adservice.com + AffVerify review + Business of Apps 2026
affiliate_networks.caveat: Adtraction is 'Not Approved' in Spirion already — Ergys to flag if Adservice rejects on same grounds

affiliate_networks.name: Lomadee
affiliate_networks.description: Leading Brazilian affiliate-marketing platform. Founded 2009, acquired by A&EIGHT (2024) and recently re-launched under original name. 1M+ affiliates, 350+ brands, placements across 100K+ Brazilian sites/groups/profiles. Pure pay-per-sale, zero setup fees. Pure ecommerce play, LATAM-dominant.
affiliate_networks.source: Ecommerce Update + Yotpo blog + LeadIQ profile

affiliate_networks.name: SalesDoubler
affiliate_networks.description: International affiliate network out of Ukraine. Multi-vertical: Fintech, E-commerce, Services, Education, Crypto. Active in CIS (KZ/MD/AZ/UZ), APAC, LATAM. CPI/CPL/CPS pricing models. Fills a GEO gap in current rosters (CIS + APAC).
affiliate_networks.source: Affpaying review + Salesdoubler.pro + Business of Apps 2026

traffic_sources.name: MyBid
traffic_sources.description: 6B daily impressions across 200+ countries. 400M popunder clicks/month. Min CPC $0.00008. Both fully-managed and self-serve options (self-serve launched 2024). Premium-positioned traffic.
traffic_sources.isp_targeting: YES — full ISP + carrier + city + region + device + OS + browser + language
traffic_sources.icloud_targeting: Not explicitly listed; carrier + iOS device filtering supported
traffic_sources.source: Mobidea Academy review + AffMaven review + Affpaying + Trustpilot + Mybid.io
traffic_sources.caveat: Trustpilot reviews mixed — some users report top-4 performance, others call it scam. Start with small test budget ($50–100) before scaling.
